en_title: 'These Decisions Are Never Easy' — Civilization Developer Firaxis Lays Off One Third of Its Workforce
cn_title: 「这些决定从来都不容易」——《文明》开发商Firaxis裁员三分之一
opus_summary: 据彭博社报道，《文明》和《幽浮》开发商Firaxis正裁减约60人，约占员工总数的三分之一，工作室负责人也将离职。2K表示，Firaxis正在重组，重新聚焦策略游戏开发。报道称，新《幽浮》游戏的开发将继续，但裁员后可能面临某种调整。

paragraphs.en: Civilization and XCOM developer Firaxis Games is laying off around 60 people, which amounts to approximately one third of its workforce, according to a Bloomberg report. The studio head of the Maryland-based development studio is also departing.
paragraphs.cn: 据彭博社报道，《文明》和《XCOM》开发商Firaxis Games正在裁员约60人，约占其员工总数的三分之一。这家位于马里兰州的开发工作室的负责人也将离职。

paragraphs.en: 2K, the publishing arm that handles Firaxis, BioShock games, the Mafia series, and various sports titles under Take-Two, gave Bloomberg a comment on the layoffs.
paragraphs.cn: Take-Two旗下负责Firaxis、《生化奇兵》游戏、《四海兄弟》系列以及多款体育游戏发行业务的2K，就此次裁员向彭博社发表了评论。

paragraphs.en: “Firaxis is restructuring and recentering around the studio’s core strength — designing world class strategy games that have set the industry standard for the genre for the last 30 years,” said a 2K spokesperson.
paragraphs.cn: 2K发言人表示：「Firaxis正在进行重组，并重新聚焦于工作室的核心优势——设计世界一流的策略游戏。过去30年来，这些游戏一直为该类型设立行业标准。」

paragraphs.en: “As part of these changes, the size of the studio is being reduced to focus on design, technology and the player experience, which means saying goodbye to talented colleagues who helped build Firaxis. These decisions are never easy, but they’re essential to build the next chapter of Firaxis.”
paragraphs.cn: 「作为这些变革的一部分，工作室正在缩减规模，以专注于设计、技术和玩家体验，这意味着我们要与帮助建设Firaxis的优秀同事告别。这些决定从来都不容易，但对于开创Firaxis的下一个篇章而言必不可少。」

paragraphs.en: The 4X strategy game series has been one of the quiet giants under the 2K label, but the most recent entry, Civilization 7, divided players. Reviews for the game on Steam are mixed, with players complaining about radical structural changes to long-standing franchise traditions, a lack of polish, and predatory implementation of monetization.
paragraphs.cn: 这个4X策略游戏系列一直是2K旗下低调的巨头之一，但最新作《文明7》让玩家意见分歧。该游戏在Steam上的评价褒贬不一，玩家抱怨其对系列长期以来的传统进行了激进的结构性改动、缺乏打磨，以及盈利机制的实施方式具有掠夺性。

paragraphs.en: According to the report, Firaxis is also working on a new game in its turn-based alien invasion series, XCOM. However, the team has been facing development struggles and recently missed a key development milestone.
paragraphs.cn: 据报道，Firaxis还在开发其回合制外星人入侵系列《XCOM》的新作。然而，团队一直面临开发难题，最近还错过了一个关键开发里程碑。

paragraphs.en: Bloomberg’s anonymous sources claim that development of the new XCOM will continue, but will likely face some kind of shakeup following the cuts to staffing.
paragraphs.cn: 彭博社的匿名消息人士称，新的《XCOM》游戏将继续开发，但在裁员后很可能会面临某种调整。

paragraphs.en: Firaxis also laid off an unannounced number of developers last year , following the launch of Civilization 7, despite 2K claiming sales of the game were “consistent with expectations.”
paragraphs.cn: 去年，《文明7》发售后，Firaxis还裁减了数量未公开的开发人员，尽管2K声称该游戏的销量「符合预期」。

paragraphs.en: The studio’s previous major launch, Marvel’s Midnight Suns, performed poorly . At the time, Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick told Bloomberg that "it's possible the release window wasn't perfect" but that he thinks it could keep selling over a long period of time.
paragraphs.cn: 该工作室此前推出的重磅作品《漫威暗夜之子》表现不佳。当时，Take-Two首席执行官Strauss Zelnick告诉彭博社，「发行时间窗口可能不够理想」，但他认为该游戏可能会在很长一段时间内持续销售。
